child.label: Social Rules of Thumb
child.description: Questions about how many people would agree with a general rule of thumb about manners, social behavior, or what is expected of people, rated from "practically no one" to "practically everyone".
child.not_for: Questions asking what the answerer thinks is the polite thing to do in a specific situation (use Everyday Manners).
examples: How many people would agree: "It is rude to leave a party without saying goodbye"?
How many people would agree: "You should tip your server"?

samples:
What should you do if you're running late to meet someone?
call_them / message_when_you_arrive / apologize_in_person_only / message_as_soon_as_you_know

When should you reply to a text from a friend?
same_day / within_minutes / within_a_few_hours / whenever_convenient

How do you prefer to greet someone you've just met?
hug / nod / wave / handshake / cheek_kiss

What should a guest bring to a dinner party?
dessert / flowers / wine_or_drinks / a_dish_to_share / nothing_unless_asked

What is the right way to thank someone for a gift?
phone_call / text_message / handwritten_note / thanking_in_person / no_formal_thanks_needed

What should you do when someone's phone keeps ringing in a quiet place?
ignore_it / give_them_a_look / politely_point_it_out / ask_staff_to_handle_it

When is it okay to use your phone at the dinner table?
never / anytime / only_for_urgent_calls / only_when_everyone_is_on_theirs

How late can you arrive at a party and still be polite?
a_little_late / exactly_on_time / fashionably_late / anytime_before_it_ends

Who should hold the door for whom?
men_for_women / nobody_needs_to / younger_for_older / whoever_arrives_first

What should you do if you receive a gift you dislike?
say_nothing / thank_them_warmly / tell_them_honestly / thank_them_and_later_exchange_it

When is it okay to leave a voicemail instead of texting?
always_fine / never_just_text / only_for_older_people / only_for_urgent_matters

What is the right amount of time to stay as a houseguest?
a_weekend / one_night / up_to_a_week / as_long_as_the_host_allows

child.label: Everyday Manners
child.description: Questions about the polite thing to do in a specific everyday situation, such as gifts, hosting, greetings, phones, texting, lateness, shoes, bills, or behavior in public.
child.not_for: Ratings of how many people would agree with a stated rule of thumb (use Social Rules of Thumb).
examples: Should you take your shoes off in someone's home?
Is it rude to leave a text on read?
